{{Short description|French physicist}}
{{Orphan|date=June 2015|att=January 2025}}

'''Dimitri Roditchev''' is a French physicist of Russian-Ukrainian origin, specializing in electronic properties of nano-materials, [[Superconductivity|superconductors]], electron transport, and [[Quantum tunnelling|quantum tunneling]] phenomena. He is a professor at [[ESPCI ParisTech]] and a research director at [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|CNRS]] (on leave from).

Laureate of Prix Louis Ancel.<ref>{{Cite web|title = Prix Louis Ancel - Société Française de Physique|url = https://www.sfpnet.fr/prix/prix-louis-ancel|website = www.sfpnet.fr|archive-date = 2015-07-09|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150709074053/https://www.sfpnet.fr/prix/prix-louis-ancel|url-status = live}}</ref> of French Physical Society ([[Société Française de Physique]]) in 2003 for his works on [[Quantum tunnelling|tunneling spectroscopy]] of [[High-temperature superconductivity|high temperature superconductors]], Dimitri Roditchev works in Laboratoire de Physique et d'Études des Matériaux<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title = Laboratoire de Physique et d'Étude des Matériaux website|url = http://www.lpem.espci.fr/spip.php?rubrique45&lang=en|website = www.lpem.espci.fr|archive-date = 2014-10-14|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20141014085419/http://www.lpem.espci.fr/spip.php?rubrique45&lang=en|url-status = live}}</ref> (LPEM) where he is team leader of QuantumSpecs<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://qs.lpem.espci.fr/home/|title = QuantumSpecs team website|date = |website = |last = |first = |archive-date = 2015-06-05|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150605202848/http://qs.lpem.espci.fr/home/|url-status = live}}</ref> group, director of joint team QuEST between the laboratories LPEM-ESPCI<ref name=":0" /> and INSP-UPMC,<ref>{{Cite web|title = Spectroscopy ov Novel Quantum States team at the Institut des NanoSciences de Paris|url = http://www.insp.upmc.fr/-Spectroscopie-des-nouveaux-etats-.html|website = www.insp.upmc.fr|archive-date = 2015-06-05|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150605120440/http://www.insp.upmc.fr/-Spectroscopie-des-nouveaux-etats-.html|url-status = live}}</ref> and member of direction board of LPEM.<ref name=":0" />

The research of Dimitri Roditchev at [[Moscow State University]] concerned studies of electronic properties of disordered [[metals]] and [[insulator (electricity)|insulator]]s, in relation with [[Metal–insulator transition|metal-insulator]] and [[Superconductor Insulator Transition|superconductor-insulator]] [[phase transition]]s. In France since 1991, his activities include basic research<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://qs.lpem.espci.fr/home/research/basic-research/|title = QuantumSpecs basic research|date = |website = |last = |first = |archive-date = 2015-06-23|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150623030424/http://qs.lpem.espci.fr/home/research/basic-research/|url-status = live}}</ref> (ultimately confined superconductivity, quantum vortex, proximity phenomena in hybrid systems, near-critical superconducting states, superconductivity of atomic layers at surfaces in relation with spin-orbit interaction, metal-insulator transition etc.<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://qs.lpem.espci.fr/accueil/publications/|title = List of relevant publications|date = |website = |last = |first = |archive-date = 2015-06-05|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150605135132/http://qs.lpem.espci.fr/accueil/publications/|url-status = live}}</ref>) and engineering of high precision cryogenic equipment for scientific research.<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://qs.lpem.espci.fr/home/research/equipment-and-development/|title = Equipment and development|date = |website = |last = |first = |archive-date = 2015-06-23|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150623030817/http://qs.lpem.espci.fr/home/research/equipment-and-development/|url-status = live}}</ref>

The teaching activity of Dimitri Roditchev includes lectures in [[Condensed matter physics|Condensed Matter Physics]] (both basic and advanced levels), advising personal research projects at l'[[ESPCI Paris PSL|ESPCI-Paris PSL]]. He is author of popular science articles and books,<ref>{{Cite web|url = http://www.cnrs.fr/paris-michel-ange/IMG/pdf/350.pdf|title = C. Noguera et D. Roditchev, " Les multiples frontières du nanomonde ", Pour la Science, no 350, 2006, p. 122|date = |website = |last = |first = |archive-date = 2015-06-05|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150605120319/http://www.cnrs.fr/paris-michel-ange/IMG/pdf/350.pdf|url-status = live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title = D.
